Hi Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

I’ve got a wee surprise planned for Gran’s 80th! Morag’s letting me have Hair by Morag to myself on Saturday 12 December from 1pm, so I can do everyone’s hair before we head out for dinner. Gran doesn’t know, so please keep it quiet!

It’ll be me, the three of you, Gran, Ava and Ruby in the chairs. I’m happy to do a cut and blow-dry for everyone, and Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray too. If you’d like colour, let me know what you have in mind by Friday 27 November so I can order everything from the wholesaler. Gran did say at Easter she’d love to go properly silver, so maybe we can make that happen for her birthday. No pressure if anyone’s only after a cut and blow-dry.

Mum, could you get Gran to the salon for 1pm without letting on what’s happening? You’re probably our best bet!

Dinner’s booked for 8.30pm that night at the Italian on Byres Road. The table’s for nine, so Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man are included too. We’ll have plenty of time to get everyone ready, then head out together.

Bring a bottle of fizz if you fancy—Morag’s happy for us to have a wee drink, as long as we tidy up afterwards. And Linda, I promise I’ll keep the colour well away from the cooker and the dog this time!

I’m absolutely buzzing to do this for Gran. Let me know what you’d like done, especially if you’re thinking about colour, and I’ll get planning.

Love,  
[Your name]
